nodes.title: DENO · Quick Start
widgets_values:
## DENO · MiniMax H3 R2V

**Tiled Sampler 1088p · 16GB and up**

Reference images → Pika 6 steps at 960×544 → trained latent upscale 2× → **DENO Tiled Sampler**: DMD, final 1 step in tiles sized for your VRAM → 1920×1088.

### How it flows
**1 · Models → 2 · Inputs → 3 · Generate 544p → 4 · Upscale ×2 + Tiled Sampler 1088p → 5 · Decode once + Save**

### Quick start
1. Update ComfyUI to v0.44.0 or newer (built-in MiniMax H3 latent upscaler), then install the models and required node packs (notes on the left).
2. In **2 · Inputs**: add reference images, write the prompt, set the starting size in Resize Box, the length in seconds and the seed. For a reference video or audio, place a Load Video or Load Audio node in the free space left of **Reference to Video** and connect it to `ref_video_0` or `ref_audio_0`.
3. Run. **3** makes the 544p video and its sound and frees VRAM, **4** upscales it 2× and finishes it tile by tile, **5** frees VRAM, decodes once and saves the MP4 with audio.

### Tiled Sampler
Set **Tile width**, **Tile height**, **Overlap X** and **Overlap Y** in pixels — multiples of 32, each overlap smaller than its tile. The defaults, 896×704 tiles with 256×320 overlap, are what we tested on 16GB: six tiles at 1920×1088. With more VRAM use larger tiles; a tile as large as the frame runs it in one piece. Measured working memory of the sampler for one 15-second tile: about 1.8 GB at 1920×1088 and 2.9 GB at 2560×1440 (sparse attention 0.15 + memory optimization; DynamicVRAM streams the model weights separately).

At every step all windows predict from the same full latent, the overlaps are blended and one update is applied to the whole frame, so there are no tile seams to repair afterwards. Audio passes through unchanged. The model is loaded once for all windows.

### Tested configuration
RTX 4060 Ti 16GB VRAM · 32GB system RAM · ComfyUI v0.44.0 · up to 15 s at 24 fps; the default length is 5 s. Sparse budget 0.15; Early/Late 0; Kitchen 64Q×64KV. Memory chunk rows 4096, native precision, QKV Auto, Standard. Keep DynamicVRAM enabled. VRAM is freed after the 544p pass, before the latent upscale, and right before the decode (VRAM Debug). Requires 16GB VRAM or more. Results do not guarantee identical memory use on every GPU.

This graph keeps only what the tiled finish needs. Color matching, tear detection and resume checkpoints are not included.

**The DENO Tiled Sampler node is in DENO Custom Nodes v0.7.126 or newer** (ComfyUI Manager: `deno-custom-nodes`). The JSON does not install Python code. See Required Node Packs.

Author: **DENO** · Workflow: **GPL-3.0-only**

[Homepage](https://denomcp.com) · [Workflow repository](https://github.com/Deno2026/deno-creator-skills)

Models and node packs retain their respective licenses and terms.

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── MiniMax-H3_DenoMix_ref2va_pruned_int8_v3.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 loras/
│   │   ├── pika_h3_flex_ref2va_v1_avg_rank_55_bf16.safetensors
│   │   └── minimax_h3_dmd_ref2va_8step_turbo_pruned.safetensors

```

## Required Node Packs

- [H3-Optimizations](https://github.com/Zironic/H3-Optimizations) · Advanced Sparse + Memory Optimization. Use the tested 64Q×64KV option; do not substitute a different geometry silently.
- [DENO Custom Nodes](https://github.com/Deno2026/comfyui-deno-custom-nodes) · v0.7.126 or newer (includes the Tiled Sampler)
- [KJNodes](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes)
- [VideoHelperSuite](https://github.com/Kosinkadink/ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite)

## Report Issue

Note: Requires ComfyUI v0.44.0 or newer (built-in MiniMax H3 latent upscaler) with Comfy Kitchen support. Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare the models above.

- If memory runs out, lower the starting resolution or duration.
- For compiler errors, check the startup option `--disable-comfy-compiler`.
- Workflow issues: [Deno2026/deno-creator-skills](https://github.com/Deno2026/deno-creator-skills/issues)

nodes.title: Prompt · Speech Guidance
widgets_values:
## Writing the prompt

Use these six sections in English and assign a role to each reference:

`subject_definitions:` → `summary:` → `retention_analysis:` → `detailed_description:` → `overall_soundscape:` → `non_diegetic_music:`

Image order starts at `<Picture 1>`. Specify which face, clothing, style or background elements to use.

### With dialogue
Keep dialogue in its original language, e.g. `<d>[English]Hello.</d>`. Use speaker IDs only for characters who speak.

### Without dialogue
Describe the intended ambience and effects in `overall_soundscape`, e.g. `Only ambient sound and sound effects are heard.` Avoid describing talking or singing.

Listen to the saved audio. Unintended speech can still occur.
